additionsThisCycle.q: What is the closing rank for AIIMS Delhi general category?
additionsThisCycle.a: AIIMS Delhi general category closing rank for MBBS sits between AIQ rank 47 and 61 across 2022 to 2025, with a hard 710+/720 expectation in NEET. The bar has held remarkably stable post-NEET-2020. Targeting AIIMS Delhi means treating sub-720 as the working ceiling, not the stretch goal.

additionsThisCycle.a: COMEDK is broadly easier than KCET because COMEDK has no negative marking and 180 questions with no chemistry numerical biases. KCET has lower negative marking but a wider PCM + Biology spread, plus 2nd-PUC-board-weight which favours Karnataka-board students. COMEDK suits a stronger-PCM applicant; KCET suits Karnataka-state high-scorers.

additionsThisCycle.q: Why is parabola asked more in JEE Advanced than Main?
additionsThisCycle.a: Parabola appears in 4-6 JEE Main questions/year vs 6-10 in JEE Advanced because Advanced rewards multi-concept problems combining parabola with calculus, vectors, or coordinate-geometry tangents. JEE Main asks parabola-only direct-application; Advanced asks parabola-as-supporting-context. Mastering parabola for Advanced gives a real edge with limited extra time investment.

additionsThisCycle.q: How many electrostatics questions in JEE Main usually?
additionsThisCycle.a: JEE Main Physics typically includes 4 to 6 electrostatics questions per shift — about 16 to 24 marks out of 100. Capacitors, electric field calculations for symmetric distributions, and Gauss's law applications dominate. Electrostatics is the highest-weight Physics chapter alongside Mechanics; mastering it gains 16+ marks consistently.

additionsThisCycle.q: Is CBT mode harder than pen-paper for NEET?
additionsThisCycle.a: CBT mode is harder for students used to pen-paper because there is no margin space for scratch calculations and navigation between questions costs 3-5 seconds extra each. CBT is easier on bubble-marking errors (zero misbubbling) and answer-changes (one click). Net difficulty depends on practice — practice 3+ CBT mocks before NEET 2027.
